parameters.help_en:
The name of the new management account.

Format: `<Prefix>@rdadmin.aliyunid.com`. The <Prefix> can contain letters, digits, and the special characters `_.-`. It must start and end with a letter or digit, and cannot contain consecutive special characters. The length of <Prefix> is 2 to 50 characters
parameters.help_zh:
新管理账号名称。

格式：`<前缀>@rdadmin.aliyunid.com`。其中，<前缀>允许输入英文字母、数字、特殊字符`_.-`，且必须以英文字母或数字开头和结尾，不能输入连续特殊字符。<前缀>的长度为2~50个字符
parameters.name: ma_name

parameters.help_en:
The secure phone number of the new management account.

If you leave this parameter empty, the secure phone number of the current logon account is used. This phone number must be the same as the one used to obtain the verification code in [SendVerificationCodeForEnableRD](~~SendVerificationCodeForEnableRD~~).

Format: `<Country code>-<Phone number>`.

<props="intl">
Mobile phone numbers in the Chinese mainland in the format `86-<Phone number>` are not supported.
</props>


<props="china">
Only mobile phone numbers in the Chinese mainland in the format `86-<Phone number>` are supported.
</props>
parameters.help_zh:
新创建管理账号的安全手机号码。

置空表示采用当前登录账号的安全手机号码。该手机号码必须与[SendVerificationCodeForEnableRD](~~SendVerificationCodeForEnableRD~~)中获取验证码时使用的手机号码一致。

格式：`<国家码>-<手机号码>`。

<props="intl">
不支持填写`86-<手机号码>`的中国内地手机号码。
</props>


<props="china">
仅支持填写`86-<手机号码>`的中国内地手机号码。
</props>
parameters.name: ma_secure_mobile_phone

parameters.help_en:
The verification code.

You can call [SendVerificationCodeForEnableRD](~~SendVerificationCodeForEnableRD~~) to obtain the verification code
parameters.help_zh:
验证码。

您可以调用[SendVerificationCodeForEnableRD](~~SendVerificationCodeForEnableRD~~)获取验证码
parameters.name: verification_code

parameters.help_en:
The method used to enable the resource directory. Valid values:

CurrentAccount: uses the current logon account to enable the resource directory.
NewManagementAccount: creates a new management account to enable the resource directory. If you select this method, you must configure `MAName`, `MASecureMobilePhone`, and `VerificationCode`
parameters.help_zh:
开通方式。取值：

CurrentAccount：使用当前登录账号开通资源目录。
NewManagementAccount：新创建管理账号开通资源目录。该方式下，您需要配置`MAName`、`MASecureMobilePhone`和`VerificationCode`
parameters.name: enable_mode

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform only a dry run for the request. Valid values:
true: performs a dry run for enabling the resource directory without actually enabling it.
false (default): enables the resource directory
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：
true：开通资源目录检查，不会实际开通资源目录。
false（默认值）：开通资源目录
parameters.name: dry_run
